notes: Reviewed against WormholeGatewayAdapter.sol, the ERC-7786 gateway/receiver bases, InteroperableAddress and Bytes helpers, Ownable. All 20 ABI functions were read (the largest, sendMessage, is 598 lines: attribute loop, chain lookup, fee quote, the Wormhole relayer call with the encoded payload, event). Loops: 1 source loop (sendMessage's attributes loop) shown as while; implicit: the bytes[] attributes decode and an encode loop. Many copy lines for the bytes slicing of interoperable addresses (exact). Only 2 P2 lines. No execution run.
summary: Faithful and fairly clean, with its one source loop present; the main defect is that custom-error reverts with arguments are hidden in free-pointer memory.
